subject: Shiny app to interact with serial data stream?

messages.author: 557f8876bd15542d
messages.subject: Shiny app to interact with serial data stream?
parts:
Is it possible or has it been done to interact with a fairly high-speed serial data stream (iterating every 50 ms), create dynamic plots, and send serial commands using Shiny?

Sorry if this is a FAQ, but I didn't see anything on the shiny.rstudio site.

Thanks.

messages.author: 557f8876bd15542d
messages.subject: Re: Shiny app to interact with serial data stream?
parts: To be more specific, this app would run on localhost and the serial stream would be a /dev on the same computer.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny app to interact with serial data stream?
parts:
50ms might be borderline, but yes, this kind of thing can be done. See the crandash example:
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-examples/tree/master/087-crandash

Especially these lines that demonstrate the technique, basically a reactive with invalidateLater:
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-examples/blob/master/087-crandash/global.R#L17-L39
